author: emilizzle
body:
Hello Avicus Staff

I'm really sorry, I thought I was quitting and I didn't mean to harm anything and I also thought it was funny at the time. I should not have done it and I apologise for any harm caused by myself advertising. I believe that I have waited long enough to be unbanned and to have a second chance. I solely regret my actions on that day, and I hope I can be granted a second chance which I will greatly appreciate.

Thank you

Pantai
